session.scope: Proposal review: understand the partial result of an import. This is not an audit of a real product.
session.authorized_changes: Local demo artifacts only. No remote changes.
limitations: There were no participants, analytics, or backend execution.
The figures illustrate synthetic counts, not a measured improvement.

conclusion.summary: Propose a persistent summary of partial results and a retry of pending items only. Hypothesis pending human validation.

evidence.location: Conceptual example included in this package
evidence.description: Simulated import with completed, rejected, and pending items. This is not an observation of people.

coverage.scope: Identify what was imported and what needs correction
coverage.reason: No test with participants was run.

coverage.scope: Do not duplicate items already imported
coverage.reason: The example does not implement a backend.

findings.title: The partial result needs a state the person can consult
findings.task: Import a selection and recover only what is pending
findings.observation: The initial proposal only considered a transient notification; this raises the risk of losing context.
findings.impact: Work could be repeated, or the result could be read as a complete failure.
findings.reach: Unknown; there is no product data.
findings.proposal: Keep a list of completed, failed, and pending items; retry only the selected ones and check the result.
findings.tradeoff: The summary takes up space; do not turn it into permanent noise.
findings.acceptance_test: Without hints, the person identifies the results and retries only what failed; a technical test checks that effects are not duplicated.

metrics.name: Correct task without reimporting completed items
metrics.population: Relevant users of the future product, to be recruited with consent
metrics.method: Comparative task test; size and decision criterion to be defined before running

decisions.question: Toast or persistent summary?
decisions.choice: Prototype a persistent summary and compare
decisions.rationale: The task continues after the message; the proposal lets the person consult the state.
alternatives: Toast with a link to the history
decisions.risk: Adding unnecessary visual containment if a sufficient history already exists
decisions.review_trigger: Inspection of the real product or task-test evidence
